## Description

A clear description of the change and the motivation behind it.

## Related issue

Closes #<!-- issue number, if applicable -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor / maintenance

## Checklist

- [ ] I have added tests that cover my changes (all new features require tests)
- [ ] The test suite passes locally (`uv run pytest`)
- [ ] Code style checks pass (`uv run ruff check src/ tests/` and
      `uv run ruff format --check src/ tests/`)
- [ ] Public functions have type hints and Google-style docstrings

## Scientific contributions

If this implements a method from a published paper, I have:

- [ ] Cited the paper in the relevant docstring
- [ ] Added a test reproducing a result from the paper where feasible
